The central figure is a woman dressed elegantly in a white, floral-patterned dress with a scalloped hemline. She is wearing a delicate necklace, a pair of high-heeled sandals, and carrying a small, light blue handbag with a tassel. Her hair is styled in an updo, and she has red lipstick, adding to her polished appearance. To her right is a man dressed in a black polo shirt and black trousers. He is wearing a gold watch on his left wrist and has a confident posture as he walks beside the woman
